runtimeSettings.title: Awọn eto asiko-ṣiṣe
runtimeSettings.description: Ṣe atunto bawo ni Novera ṣe n ṣakoso ati gbiyanju awọn olupin MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Akoko to pọju lati duro fun esi ohun elo MCP ṣaaju ki akoko to jade.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Abajade irinṣẹ to gun julọ wa ninu ibaraẹnisọrọ naa. Ohunkohun ti o kọja eyi jẹ gige ati samisi bi gige, nitorinaa abajade nla kan ko le mu ipo awoṣe naa mu. Ṣeto si 0 lati tọju awọn abajade odindi.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Nigbati o ba ṣiṣẹ, Novera yan awọn olupin MCP ti o yẹ ṣaaju awọn irinṣẹ ikojọpọ. Pa a nigbagbogbo kojọpọ atokọ ohun elo MCP kikun.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Nigbati ipa-ọna ọlọgbọn ba wa ni titan, ṣiṣe igbesẹ ipa-ọna pẹlu awoṣe lọtọ (nigbagbogbo kere) dipo awoṣe iwiregbe. Paa lati nigbagbogbo lo awoṣe iwiregbe ti nṣiṣe lọwọ fun ipa-ọna.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Yan olupese ati awoṣe ni ibi kan. Awọn awoṣe iwuwo fẹẹrẹ nikan ni a ṣe atokọ nitorinaa afisona duro ni iyara ati olowo poku.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Ko si awọn awoṣe iwuwo fẹẹrẹ wa. Ṣafikun awoṣe kekere kan tabi tunto awọn bọtini API ni Awọn awoṣe.
